Being the way I am, I have looked up the etymology of “86” before. There are myriad theories, ranging from rhyming slang with “nix” to some elaborate numerical code developed by soda jerks (e.g. www.stlmag.com/dining/Ask-G...). But I’ve never seen the one Trump floats here in print before.

I don’t think we should just shrug when senators go on TV and lie so brazenly that any viewer would know it, and don’t get contradicted by the TV host.
Yes, we see it a lot lately. But it’s just outrageous.

Somehow I only learned about the Baileys a couple weeks ago. They're an imaginary couple Chuck Schumer invented decades ago, and with whom he consults on nearly everything he does.

And even though they only exist in his mind, they both really seem to hate him.

Unclear where the bottom is for Jeff Bezos, but we clearly haven't hit it yet.

The giddiness with which Republicans are vowing that black people will have no representation in Congress is something to behold.

Tennessee is a 60-40 state, gerrymandered 8-1 GOP. Legislature is 80 percent GOP.

Now they want MAGA-fy the state's last Dem. district, in 63 percent black Memphis.

Jim Crow was in my dad's lifetime. Mass incarceration and the drug war continue in mine. The Interstate highway system and urban renewal destroyed -- and continues to destroy -- billions in heritable black wealth. And that's just the most prominent, state-endorsed, institutionalized stuff.
The past is not dead and it is hardly buried
This is actually the perfect distillation of the right wing worldview. A predatory industry treats consumers unfairly so it must be immigrants' fault.
The only negative about the second season of Deadloch is that I’m laughing so hard at the dialogue that I start losing the plot.
